assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent character sprite for original 2D mobile fishing adventure 'Farshore Fishing'. Primary request: one complete original young adult traveler seated on a small wooden fishing stool, viewed in three-quarter rear view facing up-left toward a lake. They wear a golden ochre bucket hat, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, teal expedition vest, tan shorts, brown waterproof boots, with a small russet fishing bag near feet. Their right hand holds the cork handle of a fishing rod, but omit the long rod shaft because it is animated in-game. Expressive relaxed confident pose, practical original clothing, not resembling an existing game character. Style: premium soft hand-painted game illustration, readable stylized anatomy, crisp silhouette, warm painted light, gently textured painterly shading; slightly lively and vivid while matching watercolor lake scenery. Composition: full seated figure and stool occupy center, angled toward upper-left, all feet/hat/hands visible, isolated on truly transparent background. No scenery, no ground rectangle, no text, no watermarks. Delivery should have actual alpha, not checkerboard.
